prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person wearing a black bucket hat, a dark jacket with yellow accents, and dark pants with white sneakers"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08"].

message.content: {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"P01 clearly wears a black bucket hat, a dark jacket with yellow accents on the sleeves and sides, dark pants, and white sneakers. All other individuals either lack the bucket hat, do not have yellow accents on a dark jacket, or do not match the full outfit combination. P04 and P07 wear hats but not bucket hats, and their jackets lack yellow accents. P06 has a dark jacket with yellow stripes on the pants, not the jacket. Others are either too blurry or do not match the full description."}
